notes.title: Update v0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Update v0.2.1[/b]
Notifications no longer appear if the level has been completed.
Inserted double checks for level completion or failure conditions. The failures were occurring because in one frame all the red LEDs on the level were red and then the blue LED was on. With the double checks, I added a small delay to avoid these types of situations.
Level 52 bug fixed: At level 52 I found a bug where the SW3 switch was listening to a wrong component.
Level 64 bug fixed: At level 64 the game object called NOR Gate 3 Inputs was listening to an incorrect component.
Level 75 visual bug fixed: In level 75, there was a visual bug where the striped line for the SW3 key output does not appear.
Level 85 bug fixed: At level 85, the level could be successfully completed with only 2 of the 3 LEDs lit.
Visual bug fixed in some levels: Some dotted lines were not appearing.

notes.title: Electronics Puzzle Lab is available NOW!
notes.content:
Electronics Puzzle Lab is released!!!!
Introducing Electronics Puzzle Lab: a captivating new game that challenges players to solve intricate puzzles based on real-world electronic circuits and components. Navigate through a series of increasingly complex levels, where you'll design and test your own electronic circuits to solve puzzles. With a blend of educational content and entertaining gameplay, Electronics Puzzle Lab offers a unique opportunity to learn about electronics in a fun and engaging way. Whether you're a seasoned electronics enthusiast or new to the world of circuitry, this game will spark your creativity and test your problem-solving skills. Get ready to immerse yourself in the electrifying world of Electronics Puzzle Lab!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2567620/Electronics_Puzzle_Lab/

notes.title: Game Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44542757/119d280bfeb7d20af52e463e05d1311128b154c4.gif[/img]

I am happy to announce our biggest project yet. [b]Electronics Puzzle Lab[/b] is a puzzle game based on electronics challenges.
I was inspired to make this game throughout my career working in electronics and hardware development.
We are working to make the game accessible to all audiences. For this, electronics theories and some electronic components are being adapted to facilitate the understanding of all audiences, without leaving the essence of electronics.
I'll be using the Steam feed to keep you updated on the development of the Electronics Puzzle Lab!
